summary.text: Keishan Scott is a Democratic member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 50, who assumed office on June 3, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of South Carolina and has worked as a paralegal, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Scott won a 2025 special general election for District 50, defeating William Oden, and assumed office on June 3, 2025.
The Democratic primary scheduled for June 9, 2026 was canceled, and Scott advanced without appearing on the ballot.
